tool_calls.name: run_sql
tool_calls.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH genre_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(g.Name, 'Unknown') AS genre_name,
         COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count
  FROM Genre g
  LEFT JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
  GROUP BY genre_name
  UNION
  -- include any tracks with NULL GenreId not present in Genre (shouldn't happen), handle separately
  SELECT 'Unknown' AS genre_name, COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track
  WHERE GenreId IS NULL
)
SELECT genre_name, SUM(track_count) AS track_count
FROM genre_counts
GROUP BY genre_name
ORDER BY track_count DESC;"}
